summary: Summarizes the surveys of Telnet, FTP and SMTP servers conducted by David Smallberg in late 1982 and early 1983. It counts how many hosts accepted connections for each service and compares that to the total number of hosts.

eli5.summary: A scoreboard that adds up all the weekly door-knocking surveys to show how many computers were ready.

questions: how many hosts supported telnet ftp smtp 1983
